units.function: CLI API-parity smoke tests for cost/finance/budget operations and organization, execution workspace, environment and project-workspace management.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite registers cost and workspace Commander modules, injects API base/bearer token, stubs global fetch and asserts HTTP method/path mappings against server routes.
units.keyDataModels: Company, Agent, Issue, budget incident, execution workspace, environment and environment lease, project/project workspace; cost and finance events, budget policies, runtime services and runtime commands.
units.lifecycle: Parse scripted CLI commands; query cost/org/workspace/environment state; create or mutate budgets, events, environments and project workspaces; probe deployment capability/configuration; restart services, execute runtime commands and resolve incidents.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 2/2 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It provides broad route-parity coverage across 35 operations, but asserts no payloads, response schemas, errors, authorization, idempotency, concurrency, lifecycle state machines or resulting events/audit records.
units.designRationale: Expose server operational coverage to automation and guard against API surface regressions with a compact path/method matrix rather than duplicating full server behavior tests in the CLI.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed cost attribution, budget incidents and an explicit local/remote execution-node lifecycle, including capability probing, leases, close readiness, runtime services and project workspace commands across managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the parity-matrix technique and treat environment capability, leases and workspace close-readiness as important requirements discovered by the audit. Re-abstract them into Company OS Data/Execution Node and Connector contracts with stable lifecycle codes, tenancy, responsible-human authority, idempotency and evidence; do not copy Paperclip endpoint ownership or empty generic payload patterns.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tested operational commands are actor-blind beyond bearer authentication. Budget changes/incidents, environment deletion/probing, service restart and runtime commands are consequential actions but are not bound here to goal, responsible human, risk, permission/data scope, approval digest, evidence or result.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 2 tests passed
securityFindings: A fixed bearer token and IDs prove routing only; tenant membership, per-resource capability, token audience and cross-company rejection are untested.
Generic `--payload-json {}` is accepted throughout the smoke suite, so schema validation, unknown-field rejection, secret handling and command/data injection boundaries receive no coverage.
Environment probe, runtime restart/command, deletion and budget-incident resolution have no tested approval, confirmation, idempotency key, expected revision or audit receipt.
Environment leases and workspace close-readiness are queried but no expiry, fencing, stale-holder, force-close, concurrent-command or recovery behavior is covered.
Cost and finance event creation lacks tested provenance, deduplication, currency/unit normalization, immutable source identity and correction/reversal semantics.
Organization SVG is an alternate serialized projection; the suite does not test escaping, content type, authorization or untrusted-label handling.
